CL47, for the review: every commit on feat/streamline-doctor-memory that main (90ece47) lacks, one line each. Counted with git cherry on 78df8a0: 101 commits (not 4, not 33: the branch grew since the review), plus 23 merges; 269 files, +30,461 / -9,911.

The commits before CL41's four (5a10282 to 95f0eab) are the first 27 lines (the review said 29; git cherry finds 27 against 520a624 and against 90ece47 alike: its 33 included CL41's own 2); the 4 reviewed are 52c36c7, 7930953, 34d7053, 309ba6c; everything from 4eda454 on came after the review.
